mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country notary public or issuing passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the UBO's country is a Hague Apostille member) OR consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, Her Majesty's Treasury Consolidated List, and domestic Marshall Islands PEP and restricted-persons lists. Enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval are required for any PEP or high-risk jurisdiction; all screening records are retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry online name reservation portal operated by International Registries, Inc. (register-iri.com)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in English characters using the Latin alphabet; no official transliteration into any non-Latin script is required or accepted for the certificate of incorporation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The applicant may request a single extension for an additional 30 days by resubmitting the name reservation fee before expiry. If the name is rejected, the applicant must file an administrative appeal in writing with the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry within 21 days of rejection, accompanied by a legal brief explaining why the proposed name is not confusingly similar to an existing name and does not trigger any prohibited or sensitive category.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for this AI/LLM API platform: the company must maintain a registered office in the Marshall Islands through a licensed registered agent; physical local premises are not required for non-resident business corporations. The registered agent's address serves as the statutory service address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <5% annual probability for a standard-risk, non-resident, non-licensed AI service entity); unannounced inspections are generally limited to AML compliance-flagged cases or public-interest events.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (B.C.A.), Marshall Islands Revised Code, Title 51, Sections 51-101 to 51-301
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow account requirement for a non-resident Business Corporation formed under the B.C.A.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation ratifies the subscription for 1,000 common shares by the incorporator at a par value of US$0.01 per share, such subscription being fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be maintained at the address designated by the registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that the registered agent is hereby approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following individuals are appointed as initial directors: [Director A] and [Director B], and that [Officer A] is appointed President and [Officer B] is appointed Secretary/Treasurer. RESOLVED FURTHER, that any director or officer is authorized to execute all documents and pay all fees necessary to complete the statutory formation process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the official corporate registry portal or in person at the Registrar's office. Provide the proposed corporate name, verify it is distinguishable from existing entities, and obtain a reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Identification of incorporator or authorized applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, file an amended reservation application with an alternative name or appeal the decision to the Registrar within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in accordance with B.C.A. Sections 51-101 et seq., including permitted share structure, registered agent details, and initial directors. Execute the document before a notary public and obtain the registered agent's consent.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
Consent to act as initial director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, correct the specified provisions and resubmit within 10 business days; failure to cure may result in rejection requiring complete refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Payment of Filing Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation electronically or physically to the Registrar's filing counter. Pay the statutory filing fee of US$200 via wire transfer or acceptable alternative, and retain the receipt.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for incomplete payment or accompanying documents, settle the fee discrepancy and resubmit within 7 business days to avoid deemed withdrawal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar will endorse the Articles, issue a Certificate of Incorporation, and return certified copies together with the corporate seal and record book. Verify the corporate name, registration number, and effective date.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, submit a written request for correction with the original certificate; the Registrar will issue a corrected certificate within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and Adoption of Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the initial organizational meeting (in person or by unanimous written consent). Adopt the corporate bylaws, approve the issuance of share certificates to the initial subscriber, ratify the registered office and agent, and appoint the initial officers.
required_dossiers: Organizational meeting minutes or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If organizational records are defective, the board may adopt a correcting resolution and restate the minutes; no remedy with the Registrar is needed as this step is internal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshalls Energy Authority and Environmental Protection Authority (only for physical operations within the jurisdiction)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operational or manufacturing license required for an offshore AI/LLM API platform under Marshall Islands law when no physical facility is located in-country

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no physical operations, data center, or industrial facility in the Marshall Islands; no wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste generation expected.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no on-site employees, physical premises, or occupational activity within the Marshall Islands; therefore no fire safety certification, structural load inspection, or workplace clearance is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); official portal: www.rmigovernment.org, with customs declarations processed electronically through UNCTAD ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: SOP: (1) Incorporate the Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1990 and obtain the RMI Registrar's Certificate of Incorporation; (2) expressly designate the entity as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation in its Articles of Incorporation; (3) if no business is transacted within the Marshall Islands, no RMI income-tax registration is required and no TIN or VAT ID is issued or necessary; (4) if RMI-source income later arises, file the Business/Taxpayer Registration Form with the Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance, to obtain a TIN; (5) obtain a Foreign Investment Business License only if any physical or revenue-generating activity occurs within RMI; (6) appoint and maintain a registered agent and registered office in Majuro for all statutory notices and service of process.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (non-resident domestic Business Corporation conducting zero RMI business is exempt from Marshall Islands income tax; no capital gains tax, no dividend/interest/royalty withholding to non-residents, and no VAT/GST; any RMI-source income, if it arises, would be taxed on a territorial basis only).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No domestic check-the-box election exists. Under the Business Corporations Act 1990, the Articles may elect Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status, which operates as a self-executing statutory exemption from RMI income tax provided the corporation derives no RMI-source income and maintains no permanent establishment, office, or business activity within RMI. Hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable: the Republic of the Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax treaty network (only limited arrangements under the Compact of Free Association with the United States), and the Income Tax Act 1989 (as amended) contains no hybrid entity or hybrid instrument mismatch provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT/GST/sales-and-use tax). The only indirect tax is Import Tax (customs and excise duties under the Customs Act 2014), which applies to physical goods imported into RMI and has zero nexus to intangible AI/LLM API services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST regime exists; no economic-turnover threshold can trigger VAT registration. Import Tax registration is required only for physical importers of goods into RMI (no monetary threshold; Customs Act 2014).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API filing, or digital stamping mandate exists in RMI. Customs declarations are cleared electronically through UNCTAD ASYCUDA World, but this applies exclusively to physical import/export consignments. Digital AI/LLM API token transactions and cross-border cloud payments are entirely outside any indirect-tax clearance mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: RMI has no VAT/GST, so no export zero-rating mechanism exists or is required. AI/LLM API services sold to foreign clients by a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation are outside the scope of RMI taxation when: (a) no RMI-source income is derived; (b) services are performed and consumed wholly outside RMI; (c) no fixed establishment, office, or agent in RMI concludes the contracts; and (d) proceeds are collected offshore in USD, USDC, or other cryptocurrency through foreign payment rails (e.g., Stripe). The export is presumptively tax-neutral; no refund application is necessary.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (not applicable to digital AI API services; required only for physical goods, which this scope does not contemplate)
Digital Delivery Log: API usage telemetry and token-consumption ledger evidencing offshore service delivery
Inward Remittance Certificate: Stripe settlement report or USDC/USD transaction-hash proof evidencing foreign-currency receipt from non-RMI clients
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although no zero-rating claim exists to abuse, any false declaration to the Revenue and Customs Division or the Registrar (e.g., misrepresenting non-resident status to escape taxation, or misdeclaring the nature of services to avoid customs/import tax) triggers penalties under the Income Tax Act 1989 (as amended) and Customs Act 2014: monetary penalties up to 200% of the tax or duty evaded, administrative fines up to USD 10,000 per violation, retrospective reassessment and clawback extending six years from the date of the offending filing, and imprisonment of up to three years for fraudulent misrepresentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain an independent central bank; prudential banking supervision is exercised by the Banking Commissioner, Division of Financial Services Regulation, Ministry of Finance, with de facto USD liquidity provision anchored by the U.S. Federal Reserve through the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: USD is sole legal tender and functional currency. Both current account (API subscription fees, royalties, service income) and capital account (equity injection, shareholder loans, dividend repatriation) are fully convertible; no exchange-control licenses, no prior approval, and no profit-remittance taxes apply to non-resident-owned Business Corporations in the Tax_Exempt_Zone. Practical hurdles arise only from counterparty bank KYC/OFAC screening and correspondent de-risking, not from statutory convertibility restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: RMI imposes no statutory surrender obligation: export proceeds (AI/LLM API token receipts) may be retained abroad or deposited in any licensed bank in full, with no mandatory conversion ratio, no repatriation deadline, and no dedicated export-proceeds account. Record-keeping only requires transaction-level AML/CFT trail retention under the Banking Act and APG-aligned regulations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current with sub-ledger for capital escrow reserve)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Treasury Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for regulated international EMIs (Airwallex, Payoneer, Stripe Treasury, Mercury, Circle) on a Low_Risk_Standard AI API profile, provided the BC supplies certificate of good standing, register of directors, and UBO attestation. Legal constraint: U.S.-chartered EMIs may apply jurisdictional risk overlay to RMI-registered entities; therefore primary settlement rails should be dual-track — Stripe fiat conversion plus USDC via Circle Account — with the RMI bank account as the concentration treasury, avoiding reliance on any single EMI.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permissible; RMI banking law does not mandate physical board appearance. In practice, Bank of Marshall Islands requires a 30-minute video-conference EDD interview with the sole director plus notarized/apostilled corporate extracts and register of directors; Bank of Guam mandates an in-person visit to Majuro for any account requesting ACH/sweep privileges. For a purely remote workflow, use a licensed RMI registered agent as intermediary and accept conditional sub-limits until the bank's risk committee approves.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident offshore structure without physical RMI substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Entity-substance file: registered-office service agreement, real GPU/cloud infrastructure contracts (AWS/Azure/CoreWeave), payroll and contractor registry, board minutes evidencing management from RMI, plus a 24-month cash-flow model demonstrating commercial rationality.

On-chain transaction monitoring via chainalysis-class tooling, regulated off-ramp through Circle Account (MSP license), daily token-to-fiat reconciliation ledger, audited trail from API consumption metering to USDC issuance, and a written AML policy covering virtual-asset activities.

Certified register of UBOs with passport copies, source-of-wealth statements backed by audited financials of the parent LLC/VC, notarized waivers of bank-secrecy objections, and an organizational chart of the full ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structured inbound capital injection exceeding USD 250,000 without prior banking relationship
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-funding engagement letter, share subscription agreement referencing BCA section 31, board resolution authorizing the capital increase, RMI Registrar certificate of good standing, and a legal opinion confirming exemption from Marshall Islands Income Tax Act gross revenue tax.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/PEP hits on API customers or counterparty wallets
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative-media screening reports for directors and material counterparties, OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-list checks, customer geography segmentation showing no prohibited jurisdictions, and a standing commitment to refresh screening on a 90-day cycle.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 (gpi-enabled) from the shareholder's Delaware/Hong Kong bank to the Bank of Marshall Islands USD account, remittance narrative: 'Capital Subscription, BCA sec. 31, purpose code EQUI'; pre-credit compliance requires certified subscription agreement, board resolution, certificate of good standing, and source-of-funds file. For USDC-denominated injections, settle on-chain to Circle Account, convert to USD at reference rate, then Fedwire to BMI's U.S. correspondent (BNY Mellon) with identical narrative. No RMI government pre-approval, stamp duty, or FIRC-type certificate is required; escrow account release is governed by joint-signature mandate (company attorney + bank officer).
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for cloud/GPU/API-licensing payables (AWS/Azure/CoreWeave/EOT), with U.S. beneficiaries cleared via Fedwire/CHIPS; intra-region CNH/HKD vendors paid via CHATS or USD T/T. Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) are inapplicable to intangible AI services and used only for physical GPU hardware procurement as a standby (MT700). Developer/api-model payouts run via Stripe Treasury embedded rails for low-value fiat and batch USDC transfers via Circle API for 24/7 settlement, with a nightly treasury sweep consolidating all receivable balances into the RMI concentration account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Natural hedge — full USD-denominated invoicing, eliminating derivative exposure
Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on USD/CNH and USD/EUR with top-tier international counterparty via BMI correspondent
Deliverable FX forwards on USD/EUR and USD/HKD via Bank of Guam's trading desk
Cross-currency basis swaps (non-USD revenue swap to USD) under executed ISDA/CSA and segregated margin
OTC FX options (EUR put / USD call) for contractor payroll liabilities
USDC-to-USD conversion at Circle reference rate as synthetic stablecoin liquidity hedge for staked tokens

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Business Corporation together with the annual franchise tax (annual registration renewal fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (via the RMI licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each calendar year; the filing window opens on January 1 and closes on April 30. Newly incorporated entities file their first annual report on or before the first April 30 following incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late penalty of 10% of the unpaid annual fee accrues for each month (or fractional month) after April 30, up to a maximum of 100% of the fee. Persistent non-filing or non-payment for successive years empowers the Registrar to administratively dissolve or strike the corporation from the register, extinguishing legal capacity and standing to transact.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) confirmation and update of the beneficial ownership register (with 14-day event-based updates for share transfers and control changes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations (beneficial ownership data transmitted through the approved RMI registered agent and central records repository)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed concurrently with the annual report on or before April 30; any change in beneficial ownership (e.g., AI platform share transfer, new equity investor, change of controller) must be notified within 14 calendar days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Maintenance of and timely updates to the UBO register are statutory obligations; non-compliance constitutes an offense punishable by fines of up to US$5,000 per occurrence, and the registered agent may refuse to provide Certificate of Good Standing or nominee services until the register is brought into compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered agent annual renewal, continuation of the registered office, and (optional but customary) Certificate of Good Standing issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, executed through the RMI licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before April 30 of each year, contingent on payment of all annual fees and filing of the annual report; the Certificate of Good Standing is typically issued within 3-5 business days after the annual compliance is cleared.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Without a clean annual filing, the Registrar will not issue a Certificate of Good Standing; the corporation cannot provide valid good-standing evidence to payment processors, exchanges, banks, or counterparties, and agent services may be suspended, exposing the entity to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit is imposed on a non-resident private Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. An independent audit is mandatory only if the corporation's securities are listed on a recognized stock exchange or where a shareholder resolution or business combination agreement specifically requires an audit (not applicable to the ISIC 6201 AI/LLM API operations of this entity). Banks or payment networks may contractually request audited or reviewed financial statements for credit or merchant underwriting.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act does not mandate a specified local GAAP; books and records must reflect financial statements prepared so as to present a true and fair view. Common and accepted frameworks for this non-resident AI API holding entity are IFRS or US GAAP, applied consistently. Such statements enable the corporation to generate annual financial reports and respond to board or shareholder requests.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the RMI Beneficial Ownership Regulations, the Business Corporation must establish and maintain a beneficial ownership register at its registered office. Annually, coincident with the April 30 annual report, the registered agent performs an enhanced verification of all persons holding 10% or more of the issued share capital or otherwise exercising corporate control (for this AI/LLM platform, typically institutional and seed or venture investors). Each share transfer or change of control during the year must be recorded and filed with the Registrar within 14 calendar days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders) with share-class details
Minute Book of shareholder and board meetings and written consents

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not legally required; where voluntarily engaged for investor, bank, or payment-platform diligence, a proportionate audit or review of this AI API holding entity typically costs US$3,500 - US$8,000 per year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - The Marshall Islands Income Tax Act 1989 (30 MIRC Ch.1) is strictly territorial. A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) with no income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands is entirely outside the income tax net. The RMI imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no net-worth tax, and no branch profits tax on a non-resident BC.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The effective rate is 0% by structural design; no statutory tax holiday or preferential deduction is needed because the exemption is automatic for non-resident entities. By contrast, any trade or business physically conducted inside the RMI is subject to the Business License Tax Act 1990, which levies a 3% gross revenue tax (GRT) plus license fees. That domestic regime does not apply to a pure non-resident AI/LLM API platform with no RMI-source customers, no RMI employees, and no RMI premises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI corporate income tax return exists for a non-resident BC. There is no CIT return, no dividend withholding return, and no VAT/GST registration. The only recurring statutory filing is the Corporate Annual Statement (Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 55), submitted through the RMI-licensed registered agent's delegated electronic filing portal maintained by the Registry of Corporations (Majuro).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Corporate Annual Statement and the matching annual government fee are due on or before September 30 of each calendar year; no extension is available. The fee is calculated from authorized share capital and is entirely profit-independent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of the BC's fiscal year-end (typically December 31 for the AI/LLM API token platform).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC should declare a fixed fiscal year-end and align it with the beneficial owners' residence-country tax periods to avoid mismatch audits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and street address of the RMI-licensed registered agent and the registered office (P.O. Box in Majuro).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This field must remain continuously current; lapse of the registered agent triggers deregistration and the loss of limited-liability protection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Authorized and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes, par value, and number of authorized and issued shares; this box determines the annual fee bracket.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any increase in authorized capital must be reported by immediate amendment to the Registry; omission exposes directors to fines and fee assessments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of each director and officer; nominee directors are permitted under RMI law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership particulars are simultaneously collected by the registered agent for AML/CFT purposes; a false UBO declaration is a criminal offense.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director, authorized officer, or the registered agent certifying the truth and completeness of the statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False certification constitutes an offense under the Business Corporations Act and can support veil-piercing in foreign enforcement actions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: A delinquent Annual Statement accrues a surcharge of up to 50% of the unpaid annual government fee. Continued non-payment for 90 days permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve the BC without further notice. Reinstatement requires settlement of all arrears, all surcharges, and a reinstatement fee. Because no income tax is assessed, there are no income tax late-filing penalties or daily surcharges.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - The RMI Income Tax Act imposes no dividend withholding tax, and the Business Corporations Act imposes no tax on distributions. Dividends, share buybacks, capital reductions, and liquidating distributions may be paid free of RMI tax to shareholders of any residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. The principal bilateral arrangement is the U.S.-RMI tax agreement carried over from the former Trust Territory framework, which provides no reduced withholding for an RMI zero-tax company because its limitation-on-benefits article conditions relief on treaty residence, and a BC that pays no income tax cannot establish such residence. No RMI Tax Certificate of Residence (TRC) can be obtained: the Tax and Revenue Office maintains no income tax file for a non-resident BC and will not certify residence. A foreign beneficial owner seeking treaty relief must instead rely on its own residence-state certificate and the foreign court's analysis of the RMI entity's substance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for royalties and interest paid by an RMI BC to non-residents; the RMI does not levy outbound withholding on IP royalty streams or debt interest. Treaty rate: N/A - no treaty reduction mechanism applies. Inbound U.S.-source royalties or interest paid into the platform may be exposed to U.S. 30% statutory withholding unless a U.S. statutory exemption (e.g., portfolio interest) is available; any claim of exemption requires IRS Form W-8BEN-E and a genuine commercial purpose beyond tax avoidance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in local-law terms: the RMI has no transfer pricing legislation, no arm's-length statute, no Local File or Master File obligation, and no country-by-country reporting requirement for non-resident BCs. However, foreign parent jurisdictions (notably the United States) may independently recharacterize intercompany AI/LLM service fees under IRC Section 482. Prudent compliance requires maintaining OECD-aligned transfer pricing documentation - an intercompany agreement, functional analysis, and contemporaneous pricing benchmark - whenever related-party API licensing or hosting fees are paid into or out of the platform.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) - preferred for API token licensing and usage-based LLM inference fees where external comparables exist
Resale Price Method - applicable where the BC on-sells AI subscriptions to distributors
Cost Plus Method - applicable to intercompany LLM hosting and infrastructure support services
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) - the default one-sided method for routine AI service payments
Profit Split Method - applicable to integrated API platform value chains with unique, non-routine intangibles
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) exist in the RMI; because the jurisdiction levies no income tax, there is no tax regime for an ESR to protect. Nonetheless, foreign anti-abuse doctrines (U.S. CFC/GILTI/Subpart F, EU ATAD, OECD BEPS) may disregard a substance-less BC even though no RMI penalty is triggered. The BC must retain an RMI-licensed registered agent, must not hold itself out as having RMI substance beyond a registered office, and must not claim RMI tax residence in any foreign filing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: US-Facing Tax Evasion and FATCA Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: U.S.-resident beneficial owners channel Stripe/USDC API revenue through the RMI BC, manage and control the company from the United States, and omit the income from U.S. returns, or treat the BC as a disregarded shell when it is in fact a CFC/PFIC requiring Forms 5471/8621, FATCA filings, and GILTI/Subpart F inclusions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI side: willful evasion of any assessable RMI-source tax is a criminal offense punishable by a fine of up to $10,000 and imprisonment of up to five years. U.S. side: IRC Section 7201 criminal evasion carries a fine of up to $250,000 and imprisonment of up to five years per count; IRC Section 6663 imposes a 75% civil fraud penalty; accuracy penalties of 20-40% apply; FATCA false-certification penalties of $10,000 per form and automatic 30% U.S.-source withholding under Sections 1471/1472 apply to non-compliant payees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false certifications or cause the omission are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution; U.S. courts may impose travel bans, freeze personal assets by injunction, impose personal fines, and imprison the controlling director; a foreign director's U.S. visa and entry history become affirmative evidence of willfulness in prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: RMI Domestic Tax and Business License Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the BC to conduct an actual trade or business inside the Marshall Islands - local employees, local customers, or an RMI physical office - without a Business License under the Business License Act 1990, thereby evading the 3% gross revenue tax and license fees, or filing materially false information with the Tax and Revenue Office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An unlicensed local operation receives a tax assessment retroactive to the commencement of operations with statutory interest at 10% per annum; prosecution may result in a fine of up to $5,000 and imprisonment of up to 12 months; a false return triggers the full assessment plus a penalty of 50% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause unlicensed local trading are personally liable for the unpaid gross revenue tax; the corporate veil is pierced where the BC is used as a facade or alter ego, and directors face civil restitution, statutory disqualification orders, and exit prohibitions creating de facto travel bans within RMI jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Deficit (EU Listing and De-Risking Risk)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The BC has no RMI office, no employees, no local management, and no genuine commercial purpose beyond holding token-based receivables; the entity is screened as a zero-tax vehicle under EU Annex II (grey-list) criteria and under U.S. CFC/NRPV analysis, and foreign tax administrations characterize the structure as an abuse of law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No RMI ESR penalty applies, but the extraterritorial consequences are equivalent: foreign courts may disregard the entity and impose entity-level penalties (U.S. 25% CFC foreign base company income recharacterization; EU ATAD anti-abuse assessments); payment infrastructure (Stripe, correspondent banks, and regulated crypto exchanges) will terminate the account for de-risking; the RMI Registrar may strike the company for unpaid fees, leaving executory contracts personal to the directors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors face personal exposure through foreign discovery orders and contempt sanctions, including travel bans; a U.S. or EU court may order veil-piercing so that shareholders and directors become personally liable for the entity's obligations; sanctions designations block international travel and freeze personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Offense and Digital-Asset Payment Rail Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly accepting USDC or fiat payments derived from fraud, ransomware, or sanctions-evasion schemes; deliberately splitting USDC transfers to remain below AML reporting thresholds; misrepresenting beneficial ownership to the registered agent; or structuring transactions to evade the RMI's AML/CFT obligations under its Financial Action Task Force commitments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Crimes Act 2013, money laundering is punishable by imprisonment of up to 20 years and a fine of up to $2,000,000 or twice the value of the laundered property, whichever is greater; the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze and forfeit assets; U.S. wire fraud (18 U.S.C. 1343) applies where Stripe or correspondent banks clear the transfers, adding penalties of up to $250,000 and 20 years of imprisonment per count.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal liability attaches personally to the directing mind and willful participant; sanctions include personal asset forfeiture, mandatory restitution, travel bans pending trial, and extradition exposure under existing mutual legal assistance channels; a conviction in the RMI or the United States permanently bars directors from banking, residency, and professional licensing.
